{{Top|leg}}
The '''Spirit of Battle''' was a state that [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] warriors entered into where they wholly gave themselves over to combat. During a fight, Em'liy allowed the course of a battle to dictate their thoughts and actions, resulting in a ferocity that many other [[Species/Legends|species]] could not match. Although outside observers likened the state to a form of "berserker" behavior, this was not accurate as Em'liy maintained control of their actions and the Spirit of Battle actually allowed them to refine that control. [[Jedi historian]]s studying the Spirit of Battle theorized that it was an unexplored manifestation of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]; however, their theories went untested as their initial investigations began shortly before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|exterminated]].<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
